name: changelog-recap
description: Turn commits since a ref into grouped release notes
prompt:
When asked what changed since a tag, commit, or date:
1. Run git log <ref>..HEAD --oneline to list commits (substitute the given ref; default to the last tag via git describe --tags --abbrev=0).
2. Run git diff <ref>..HEAD --stat to see the blast radius per file.
3. Group the changes: Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed, then chore/internal last.
4. Write each entry as one plain-language line, keeping issue or PR numbers from commit messages.
5. End with a suggested version bump (major/minor/patch) and a ready-to-paste version heading with today's date.
examples: draft release notes for the last 2 weeks
